title: Upcoming Regulatory Storm in the EU: Roblox and ChatGPT Face the Toughest Compliance Challenges
excerpt: As the user base continues to grow and various security controversies continue to escalate, the European Commission is preparing to formally include online gami
content_html:
As the user base continues to grow and various security controversies continue to escalate, the European Commission is preparing to formally include online gaming platforms Roblox and artificial intelligence applications ChatGPT within the strictest regulatory framework of the Digital Services Act (DSA).

According to EU standards, services with more than 45 million monthly active users in the EU are subject to this regulation. Both platforms have reported user data that has already exceeded this threshold. EU officials have confirmed that it is highly likely that they will be designated as "very large online platforms" or "very large online search engines," and the relevant designation is expected to be finalized soon.

Once classified, companies will have a four-month compliance buffer period. Their core obligations include significantly increasing the transparency of service terms, advertising delivery, algorithmic recommendations, and content moderation mechanisms; proactively reporting suspected illegal activities to regulators; and conducting comprehensive assessments of systemic risks related to illegal content, child protection, user well-being, and public safety.

In addition, the relevant companies must undergo annual third-party independent audits, establish internal compliance teams, and provide necessary data interfaces to regulatory authorities and trusted researchers. For systems providing recommendation algorithms, platforms must offer non-personalized options that do not rely on user profiles. If companies fail to fulfill their obligations, they may face substantial fines of up to 6% of their global annual turnover.

As a popular interactive space among young people, Roblox has recently faced lawsuits in multiple regions due to insufficient safeguards for minors. Previously, it had introduced age verification and age-based chat protection tools. Meanwhile, as a representative of generative AI, ChatGPT has also faced legal lawsuits in multiple locations due to potential safety risks. Industry analysts point out that this regulatory upgrade will further strengthen the platform's responsibility, marking a key step in enhancing the governance of the online ecosystem.

content_html_zh:
随着用户群不断增长以及各种安全争议不断升级，欧盟委员会正准备将在线游戏平台 Roblox 和人工智能应用 ChatGPT 正式纳入《数字服务法》（DSA）最严格的监管框架内。

根据欧盟标准，欧盟境内月活跃用户超过4500万的服务均受此监管。 两个平台报告的用户数据均已超过此阈值。 欧盟官员已确认，它们极有可能被指定为“超大型在线平台”或“超大型在线搜索引擎”，相关指定预计很快就会敲定。

一旦分类，公司将有四个月的合规缓冲期。 他们的核心义务包括显着提高服务条款、广告投放、算法推荐和内容审核机制的透明度；主动向监管机构举报涉嫌违法行为；全面评估非法内容、儿童保护、用户福祉、公共安全等系统性风险。

此外，相关企业必须每年接受第三方独立审计，建立内部合规团队，并向监管机构和值得信赖的研究人员提供必要的数据接口。 对于提供推荐算法的系统，平台必须提供不依赖于用户配置文件的非个性化选项。 如果公司未能履行义务，他们可能会面临高达全球年营业额 6% 的巨额罚款。

作为深受年轻人喜爱的互动空间，Roblox 近期因未成年人保障不足而面临多个地区的诉讼。 此前，它推出了年龄验证和基于年龄的聊天保护工具。 同时，作为生成式AI的代表，ChatGPT也因存在安全隐患而面临多地法律诉讼。 业内分析人士指出，本次监管升级将进一步强化平台责任，标志着加强网络生态治理迈出关键一步。
